extension.summary: Shared install library for the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons
extension.description: Internal Python library used by the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons. It is not runnable on its own and does not appear on the home screen; it provides the shared add-on install, dependency-resolution and Kodi-integration machinery the Setup add-ons depend on.
extension.news: v1.6.0: Fix: EZ Maintenance++ backup now actually installs (previously wired but never called). Fix: Guided wizard re-checks real Foundation config, not just skin state. v1.5.0: Onboarding self-creates the _T7B/kodi/{backups,iptv,media,repositories,rss} device tree (ensure_device_dirs / DEVICE_STAGING_SUBDIRS); IPTV staging is injected only when the iptv/ dir actually holds artifacts. (v1.4.0: Device-resident master env at the _T7B/ brand root (dot-optional env.<device>), ordered env-source search (brand root -> staging _T7B/kodi/ -> legacy kodi/tony.7.bones/ -> profile-local), persistent master never deleted, self-scaffolding placeholder template when no env exists. (v1.3.0: Ordered env-source layer — BOX_ENV_PATH (pushed env wins) then the profile-local env, with read_first_env/box_env_paths/delete_box_envs helpers and terminal deletes covering every candidate; SETUP_API 2. (v1.2.0: Modular Setup layers — re-entrant apply_foundation/apply_iptv/apply_addons (each leaves a complete working box), installed-state probes + assert_box_complete (dependency-closure walk), the PVR-disabled config window for pvr.iptvsimple instance-settings writes, staged-IPTV artifact consumption (host-built m3u/groups/instance files), keep-skin activation hardening (verify-then-re-assert with skinshortcuts quiescence), and the SETUP_API version guard.)
